title: People Through Change: An ADKAR® Introduction
summary: Practice noticing individual change barriers and selecting proportionate support through an original workplace scenario. Independent educational portfolio sample.

title: Adult Learning Theory: Design for the People Doing the Work
summary: A 25-minute portfolio sample: use adult-learning assumptions to redesign a fictional service-desk rollout, choose appropriate support, and separate learning gaps from work-system barriers.

title: Bloom’s Taxonomy: Match the Learning to the Work
summary: A 25-minute portfolio sample: use the revised taxonomy to classify workplace tasks, sharpen objectives, and align practice with assessment.

title: Confluence Cloud: Publish a Runbook People Can Use
summary: Convert scattered handover notes into a findable, reviewed support runbook with a safe audience and a maintenance plan. Estimated completion time: 28 minutes, including practice and assessment; learner pace varies.

title: EBITDA: Read the Number, Ask Better Questions
summary: Build and check a simple EBITDA reconciliation, then explain why the result cannot answer every business question. An independent, scenario-based portfolio sample.

title: Jira Cloud: Turn a Bug Report into Ready-to-Test Work
summary: Take a vague report through duplicate checking, reproducible evidence, ownership, a blocked handoff, and evidence-based closure. Estimated completion time: 28 minutes, including practice and assessment; learner pace varies.

title: SAP Fieldglass: Review Time Sheets with Confidence
summary: Practice a buyer-side supervisor’s review: match the record, reconcile hours, return a precise correction, and verify the next workflow state. Estimated completion time: 28 minutes, including practice and assessment; learner pace varies.
